text:
alex: FYI — nrt-east1 cluster bring-up is stuck, most GPU nodes are failing to join the k8s control plane. Seeing lots of certificate / kubelet errors in the bootstrap logs.
priya: Copy. Can you paste the first failing log lines?
alex: sure, from the node bootstrap (`journalctl -u kubelet -n 60`):
```
Mar 10 04:12:05 nrt-edge-02 kubelet[1234]: E0310 04:12:05.123456    1234 kubelet.go:220] ServerTLS: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority (possibly because of clock skew)
Mar 10 04:12:05 nrt-edge-02 kubelet[1234]: F0310 04:12:05.123456    1234 server.go:123] failed to fetch ca cert: GET https://10.0.0.1:6443/healthz: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid
```
alex: also saw a ton of `kernel: NTP: CLOCK_SKEW detected` in dmesg on some nodes.
jonathan: hmm, clock skew + cert errors usually means NTP/chrony didn't start or AMI image has wrong timezone/ntp config. Do we have the AMI preflight script that checks `chronyc tracking`?
maia: preflight runbook should check `chronyc sources` and `timedatectl` before kubelet. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bringup-nrt (runbook v2).
alex: preflight shows chrony service failing to start because of missing `/etc/chrony/chrony.conf` on this AMI variant. Looks like the `packer` job used a minimal image without the chrony package.
priya: Ugh. Which AMI tag did packer produce?
alex: ami-0b7cdeadbeef-2026-12-15 (packer-build-ami-edge-minimal).
jonathan: that AMI was supposed to be tested for infra builds — looks like a packaging regression. Also, I see GPU driver handshake errors after kubelet tries to start: `nvidia-smi: driver not loaded` in the bootstrap logs. So two independent failures: time sync -> certs, and GPU driver missing -> node not schedulable for inference.
ops-oncall: Are we blocked on capacity for the region because these nodes never join? Do we have fallback pools in apac-west1?
alex: yes, we're currently routing new capacity to apac-west1 as a temporary fallback. But customers expecting nrt-east1 will hit higher egress/costs. Cost estimate if failover continues: ~+18% vGPU cost for next 48h.
maia: Action items: 1) stop new launches using the `edge-minimal` AMI, 2) revert packer to previous AMI, 3) apply a hotfix to bootstrap to install chrony if missing, 4) re-run driver install validation.
priya: I'll coordinate the AMI rollback. alex, can you draft the hotfix script? Keep it idempotent and safe for existing nodes.
alex: on it. Draft hotfix (will run as userdata on new launches):
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
if ! command -v chronyc >/dev/null; then
  apt-get update && apt-get install -y chrony || yum install -y chrony
fi
systemctl enable --now chronyd || systemctl enable --now chrony || true
chronyc sources || true
# GPU driver sanity check
if ! command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null; then
  /opt/install-scripts/install-nvidia-driver.sh || echo "driver install failed"
fi
```
alex: posting PR for this now.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: hotfix/chrony-driver-preflight -> staging (ci/1234).
priya: Rolling AMI back to ami-0aabbccddee-2026-11-01 which had chrony & driver preinstalled. Will kick off a new fleet launch in ~15m after validation.
jonathan: For handoff/runbook update: add `timedatectl` and `chronyc tracking` to preflight checks. Also add quick `nvidia-smi` check and `modprobe nvidia` step. I'm editing runbook v2.
maia: Also add a short note about cost fallback policy and how to notify sales + customer success when we failover regions. We hit that last quarter and CS got surprised.
ops-oncall: I'll prepare the incident note and set the status to `investigating` in the incident channel. If AMI rollback succeeds, change to `partial mitigation`.
alex: quick test results after hotfix applied to one new node (userdata via launch template):
```
# after userdata
chronyc tracking: Reference ID: 1A2B3C4D
System time: 0.003s SYSTIME
nvidia-smi: NVIDIA-SMI 535.54       Driver Version: 535.54
kubelet: node registered, kube-proxy healthy
```
alex: looks good on the canary. Re-launching remaining instances.
priya: rollback completed, new fleet is coming up. I'll post when 90% of nodes are Ready.
maia: thanks. After handoff, update runbook, tag the AMI as `edge-minimal-broken` and remove from auto-launch lists.
ops-oncall: incident created: INC-2026-0310-NRT-BOOT. Adding CS, sales, and infra lead.
alex: final note — root cause: packer change removed chrony from the AMI and an unrelated driver packaging change meant the driver wasn't preinstalled. Two small regressions combined to block bring-up. Will add a CI gate to catch missing chrony and `nvidia-smi` in AMI build pipeline.
maia: excellent. Good catch and tidy rollback. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: hotfix/chrony-driver-preflight -> staging (ci/1234); promoted to prod (ci/1234)
priya: 90% nodes Ready at 04:31 UTC. Closing this thread once incident note is finalized.
jonathan: please attach scrubbed logs to the incident for postmortem.
ops-oncall: will do.
